purpose: Deterministic expected results for the C08 Documents workflow. Every value below is checkable against the fixture text; nothing here is a model judgement.
not_a_benchmark: These are correctness expectations for extraction and citation, not a quality score. A model answer that is fluent and wrong still fails them.

inspection-report-scan.pdf.role: raster scan of the inspection report
inspection-report-scan.pdf.page_marker: none - this is an image, page numbers are PDF pages
inspection-report-scan.pdf.why: The extraction pipeline must read pixels. The .txt is what a correct reading produces; this is what it has to read to get there.

expected_missing.why: SOP-MECH-014 2.3 forbids entering a missing reading as zero, as in specification, or inferred from a previous report. A pipeline that fills this field has fabricated a measurement.

expected_missing.reason: torque was not recorded at the time of inspection

expected_missing.reported_as: not countersigned at time of issue

expected_uncertainty.why: the report says 'no through-wall loss observed' and gives no depth; a numeric depth in the output is invented.

expected_findings.claim: drive-end vibration exceeds the alarm limit

action_clause.quote: 3.1  A vibration alarm requires re-inspection within 14 days.

expected_findings.claim: two baseplate anchor bolts are loose
expected_findings.required_action: re-torque to 95 Nm and record the value

action_clause.quote: 3.3  Loose baseplate anchor bolts shall be re-torqued to 95 Nm

expected_findings.claim: suction pressure could not be verified
expected_findings.required_action: list as an open item; replace the gauge before the next routine inspection

action_clause.quote: 5.2  An approval note shall list every value the report recorded as

trap_expectations.wrong_answer: the pump must be removed from service because vibration is in alarm
trap_expectations.correct_answer: the pump may remain in service; SOP-MECH-014 3.2 says a vibration alarm alone does not require removal, and bearing temperature is within limit
trap_expectations.why: this is the plausible-sounding wrong conclusion the SOP explicitly rules out, so it separates reading the SOP from guessing.

trap_expectations.correct_answer: not recorded, because the gauge was illegible

scan_binding.note: Scan PDF page N renders text page N, plus a 'SYNTHETIC SCAN - PAGE N' banner. Every expectation below that cites inspection-report.txt page N is equally an expectation against scan page N; `scan_page` states it explicitly so a C08 check does not have to infer it.
scan_binding.banner_on_every_page: SYNTHETIC SCAN - PAGE {n} - NOT A REAL DOCUMENT

ocr_expectations.not_implemented_here: C07 supplies the fixture. Rendering and OCR are C08 and are planned in docs/c08-dependency-plan.md.
ocr_expectations.minimum_bar: Every value in expected_facts whose source is inspection-report.txt must be recoverable from the scan page named in scan_page.
ocr_expectations.known_difficulty: The render is a 5x7 bitmap font at 150 DPI with deterministic speckle. It is uniform and clean compared with a real scan, so passing this is a floor, not evidence of production OCR quality.
ocr_expectations.must_not_shortcut: The PDF carries no text layer and no font resource. A pipeline that returns text without OCR has read something other than this file.
